description: A low drum between two wings with a covered passage cut straight through the middle of it at ground level, from Kerbstone Row to the lane behind. The passage is not a courtesy: it is an ancient footpath the estate could not extinguish, and the building was designed round it after a year of trying not to. The passage mouth on Kerbstone Row is the way in and there is no door on it at all, because a door on it would be the one thing the award specifically forbids.
